Fast Fourier transform

Source: R/lax_fft.R
lax_fft.Rd

Port of jax.lax.fft: an FFT over the trailing length(fft_lengths) dimensions of x. RFFT converts x to an inexact real dtype and returns the fft_lengths[n] %/% 2 + 1 non-negative frequency terms of the last dimension; the other types convert x to a complex dtype. IRFFT returns a real array whose trailing dimensions are fft_lengths.

Usage

lax_fft(x, fft_type, fft_lengths)

Arguments

x

Array.

fft_type

One of "FFT", "IFFT", "RFFT", "IRFFT" (or lower case), or a value of lax_FftType.

fft_lengths

Integer vector of transform lengths (at most 3 for XLA).

Value

An array.
